blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Secretary Juan Miguel “Mitch” Cuna of the Department of Environment and Natural Resources has called for urgent, rights-based international action to address forced climate displacement, describing climate mobility as the “true human face of the climate crisis.” According to a DENR statement on Wednesday, Cuna made the call last Sept. 23 in his address at the High-Level Breakfast for Climate Mobility Champions at Scandinavia House in New York City during the 81st United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) High-Level Week.
